question: The value of (cosec x + cot x + 1) (sec x − tan x - 1) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to question,

(cosec x + cot x + 1) (sec x − tan x − 1)

= (1/sinx + cosx/sinx + 1)(1/cosx - sinx/cosx - 1)

= (1 + cosx + sinx)(1 - sinx - cosx)/sinx cosx

= {1² - ( cosx + sinx )²}/sinx cosx

= {1 - (cos²x + sin²x + 2 sinx cosx)}/sinx cos x

= {1 - 1 - 2 sinx cosx }/ sinx cosx

= - 2 sinx cosx/sinx cosx

= - 2

**Hence, The Required value is - 2.**
